label: Landgrove
header:
# Landgrove municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Landgrove's three selectboard members as Benjamin Freeman, Steve Hall (Chair), and Will Reed
Town of Landgrove (official website), Town Gov't page, '2026 Elected Town Officers' list: the Selectboard is Steve Hall, Benjamin Freeman, and Will Reed
Town of Landgrove (official website), Town Gov't page: Chrystal Cleary is Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Chrystal Cleary as Landgrove's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Chrystal Cleary as Landgrove's town clerk contact
Town of Landgrove (official website), Town Gov't page: Andrea Ogden is Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Andrea Ogden as Landgrove's treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Andrea Ogden as Landgrove's town treasurer contact

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 2026 Warning (Article 1) elects a Moderator; the town's post-meeting '2026 Elected Town Officers' page omits the office, so the 2026 outcome is unpublished and the post is created without a membership. Claudia Harris held the office before 2026
Town of Landgrove (official website), Lister Information page: the Listers are Kevin Dommenge, Blair McCaw, and Jonathan Bigelow
Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers Elected' table: Listers Kevin Dommenge, Blair McCaw, and Jonathan Bigelow (Bigelow re-elected in 2026)

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers Elected' table: Auditors Elizabeth Dee (styled 'Liza Dee' in the table, to 2028), Tove Stigum (re-elected to the seat expiring 2029), and Brent Johnson (elected to the one-year seat expiring 2027)
Town of Landgrove (official website), Cemeteries page, '2026 Cemetery Commission members': Jonathan Bigelow, Mat Degan, Greg Eckhardt, Jillian Joyce, and Jeremiah Evarts

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers Elected' table: five Cemetery Commissioners on five-year staggered terms; the 2026 Warning carried two cemetery articles (a five-year seat, won by Bigelow, and the vacant seat's four-year remainder to 2030, held by Evarts)
Town of Landgrove (official website), Town Gov't page: Andrea Ogden is Collector of Delinquent Taxes
Town of Landgrove (official website), Town Gov't page: John Wiley is Constable

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers Elected' table: Trustees of Public Funds Jamie Wiley (the table spells the name 'Wylie' once; 'Wiley' governs, to 2028), Andrea Ogden (re-elected), and Sarah Waite (to 2027)

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 2026 Warning (Article 1) elects a Grand Juror; the town's post-meeting '2026 Elected Town Officers' page omits the office, so the 2026 outcome is unpublished and the post is created without a membership. Claudia Harris held the office before 2026

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names five justices of the peace for Landgrove: John Ogden, Chuck Sweetman, Claudia Harris, Virginia LaPrade, and Steve Hall

Town of Landgrove, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers Elected' table prints the JP block as Charles Sweetman (recorded so here) and names Charlie Howard where the certified listing names John Ogden; the certified listing governs
